I submitted no jobs. The value comes from the garnet default calibration set edea61a8-0087-446a-836a-66ff46ee5413, read with GET /api/v1/calibration-sets/garnet/default/metrics. The metric field is metrics.irb.cz.slepian_crf.QB12__QB17.fidelity:par=d2, and its uncertainty is about 0.00037. slepian_crf is the only CZ implementation on garnet, and it is the default one. The metric set has 30 IRB CZ observations, and none of them is marked invalid. QB12-QB7 is a very close second at 0.9987763136911908, with an uncertainty of about 0.0004. The gap between the two pairs is about 1e-6. That is far smaller than the error bars, so the two pairs are statistically tied. QB12-QB17 is still the highest value as reported. The helper command "iqm_run.py calib garnet" and my own direct check of the raw metrics gave the same ranking.
